operation.summary: Fetch the same template origin. An unchanged applet gets an owner update review; a customized applet gets a local three-way upgrade task. Nothing applies automatically or calls a model. Read development first

body.name: package
body.description: The applet file itself: a bridgit-template/1 definition with runtime.adapter bridgit.package.v1 (legacy alias android.package.v1; see https://bridgit.cc/learn/builder/applet-packages.md)

body.name: url
body.description: Instead of package: an https://bridgit.cc/… package file (for example a recipe's applet.json)

body.name: template
body.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)

body.name: bundled
body.description: Instead of package/url/template: a built-in applet id (including a-sorta-fairytale-about-me, chef-helper, insurance-inventory, exercise-check); downloads its registry release

body.name: config
body.description: Values for the applet's blanks (config_schema); the rest use defaults. The owner can still change them on the review screen

body.name: expected_revision
body.description: revision from development; use url, template+revision or bundled, not an inline package

operation.returns: status:awaiting_owner with id (pending review), review and expected_revision for unchanged applets; otherwise task{id, type:applet.template_upgrade, status:needs_agent|needs_verification, expected_revision, candidate, conflicts, incoming, guide} or status:up_to_date; no automatic activation

template.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)

expected_revision.description: revision from development; use url, template+revision or bundled, not an inline package
